node.reason: 5.2.0 republishes the Node SDK, carrying everything since the last npm release (5.0.0): the Team Tasks surface (createTeamTask/appendTeamTaskEvent/updateTeamTask, +3 methods, landed in 5.1.0 but never published) and the new default 30s request timeout (timeoutMs constructor option, ETIMEDOUT on expiry). 5.1.0 never reached npm; the registry jumps 5.0.0 -> 5.2.0.

python.reason: 5.2.0 is platform-only for Python - no Python SDK source change since the last release; the version advances per the unified model but the SDK is NOT republished; PyPI stays at the last SDK release.

reason: 5.2.0 is the production-readiness pass: catastrophe pack auto-seeds for new self-hosted orgs, dashclaw install claude defaults fresh installs to enforce (CLI 0.9.0), SessionStart liveness probe wired, embedded-postgres stdout-drain hang fixed, one authoritative release:check gate, scheduled-ops timeouts, db-only compose, and the Mission Control -> Approvals sweep. Also repairs the v5.1.0 release record (contract drift, missing changelog/tag).
